name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, after providing catering services for a small rally event in the Atacama Desert. His traditional Chilean empanadas and hearty stews were a hit with the teams, and he soon found himself drawn into the high-octane world. He brings a meticulous approach to his role, ensuring that the team's dietary needs are met with both nutrition and flavor. He strongly believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. 

Joining RFK Racing was a dream come true for Ricardo. He's committed to providing high-quality, culturally-relevant meals that cater to the diverse palates within the team. He continuously seeks innovative ways to improve the catering experience, incorporating local ingredients and sustainable practices whenever possible. His reliability and dedication have made him an invaluable asset to the team, consistently providing a taste of home on the road.

Ricardo's ambition is not just to provide food, but to create a communal dining experience that fosters camaraderie and boosts team morale. He prides himself on knowing each team member's preferences and dietary restrictions. He envisions a future where motorsport catering is recognized as an integral part of performance optimization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a warm smile and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using only fresh, locally-sourced ingredients, even if it means driving miles to find them.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and menu ideas.
Unintentionally refers to racing cars as 'those beautiful beasts' during meal prep meetings.
